# Perlette Cakes

Perlette Cakes is a home-based baker in Klang Valley, Malaysia.

The public website is being developed to include a menu-based order-request flow. Customers can currently contact Perlette Cakes on WhatsApp with order questions.

## Business Summary

- Products: custom celebration cakes, cupcakes, pastries, and cookies
- Delivery: across Klang Valley via Lalamove
- Pickup: not offered
- Lead time: usually 3 to 5 days, with more notice needed for larger or more detailed orders
- Ordering: menu-based order requests are in development; WhatsApp remains available for questions
- WhatsApp: +60 19-650 5050
